text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HET FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- New chairman of FNV industrial workers union calls for one single undivided union. (p1)
- Majority in parliament disagrees with traffic minister Annemarie Jorritsma on introduction of more competition for Dutch Rail NS. (p1)
- Insurer Stad Rotterdam, soon to merge with insurer De Amersfoortse, targets at a quick takeover. (p1)
- Insurer Levob sees 1996 net drop 1.2 million guilders to 24.2 million, mainly through losses on recreation projects. (p1)
- Agricultural minister Jozias van Aartsen tightens measures against swine fever epidemic. (p1)
- ABN Amro bank gets U.S. Federal Reserve approval for taking over Standard Federal Bancorporation. (p3)
- Tank storage and shipping concern Van Ommeren forecasts at least 100 million guilder net profit this year. (p3)
- Builder NBM Amstelland targets at growth in trade and industry. (p4)
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Cabinet seeking to promote investment in environment-friendly projects. (p1)
- Jan Oosterveld, Philips Electronics new senior director, to pave the electronics giant's way into the 21st century. (p2)
- Insurer Stad Rotterdam wants to remain sponsor of soccer club Feyenoord despite recent hooligan problems. (p2)
- Industrial gasses group Hoek Loos sees sales drop 40 pct in the last years due to less leakages through tighter environmental rules. (p15)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Parliament presses justice minister Winnie Sorgdrager to consider stopping automatic reduction of prison sentences. (p1)
- Accountancy Deloitte & Touche reprimanded over annual accounts of now defunct life-insurer Vie d'Or. (p25)
- Publisher De Telegraaf gives up plans to takeover Het Financieele Dagblad. (p25)
- ABN AMRO to step up measures against internal fraud. (p29) TROUW
- Insurer Delta Lloyd and Triodos Bank to launch new investment fund. (p7)
- ASN bank no longer holds Ahold shares, because of doubts about the retailer's social policy. (p7)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Amsterdam Schiphol Airport makes takeover bid for two Australian airports, including Brisbane. (p11)
